description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Cho'Gath''' attempts to eat the target enemy, dealing them [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage. Against non-[[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]], the '''base''' damage is modified.
description.text: Active: Cho'Gath attempts to eat the target enemy, dealing them  true damage. Against non- champions, the base damage is modified.

description2.raw: If the target is killed, '''Cho'Gath''' gains a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Feast''. Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] or [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].
description2.text: If the target is killed, Cho'Gath gains a stack of Feast. Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic monsters or minions.

description3.raw: Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the cast range of the ability by 2.5, for a maximum increase of 25 at 10 stacks, and grants '''Cho'Gath''' [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''bonus''' health as well as [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] '''bonus''' attack range and increased [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]], capping at [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 75 '''bonus''' attack range and 100% increased size.
description3.text: Each stack of Feast increases the cast range of the ability by 2.5, for a maximum increase of 25 at 10 stacks, and grants Cho'Gath  bonus health as well as  bonus attack range and increased size, capping at  75 bonus attack range and 100% increased size.

notes.raw: * The increased size stacks additively with other size increases. * The name of the bonus health buff is ''"Feast"''. * The bonus attack range and increase size cap at respectively 16.25 / 13.93 / 12.19 / 10.83 / 9.75 and 16.67 / 14.29 / 12.5 / 11.11 / 10 stacks, with the last stack being effective as the decimal part of the value (no decimal meaning 100% as effective). * Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the damage by 8 / 12 / 16. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable). * If an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] has health below the amount of true damage ''Feast'' deals, they will be marked for execution. This indicator does not consider [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]] or [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerability]]. * Consuming any additional [[File:VoidgrubSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Voidgrub|An icon representing Voidgrub]] [[Voidgrub|Voidgrubs]] from the same spawn group will be tracked as a "monster eaten" for ''Feast's'' buff, but will neither grant any bonuses nor count towards the 6-stack limit.(bug) * While not on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown, ''Feast's'' ability icon on the HUD can be [[ping|pinged]] to announce its damage to [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] in the ally chat. [[File:Feast_Execute_Indicator.png|thumb|left|150px|This indicator is only visible to '''Cho'Gath'''.]]
notes.text:
The increased size stacks additively with other size increases.
The name of the bonus health buff is "Feast".
The bonus attack range and increase size cap at respectively 16.25 / 13.93 / 12.19 / 10.83 / 9.75 and 16.67 / 14.29 / 12.5 / 11.11 / 10 stacks, with the last stack being effective as the decimal part of the value (no decimal meaning 100% as effective).
Each stack of Feast increases the damage by 8 / 12 / 16.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
If an enemy champion has health below the amount of true damage Feast deals, they will be marked for execution. This indicator does not consider shields or invulnerability.
Consuming any additional Voidgrubs from the same spawn group will be tracked as a "monster eaten" for Feast's buff, but will neither grant any bonuses nor count towards the 6-stack limit.(bug)
While not on  cooldown, Feast's ability icon on the HUD can be pinged to announce its damage to monsters in the ally chat.
